Long Time No Sea by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 In Old Seagrove, tucked beneath the towering oaks, rests a stunning retreat. With equal parts coastal charm, and resort-style luxury, welcome to Long Time No Sea. The backyard is pure vacation bliss, with a sparkling pool, fire pit, gas grill, comfy loungers, and an outdoor dining setup perfect for lazy lunches or sunset feasts. Inside, soaring ceilings and chic coastal décor set the tone for relaxation. The gourmet kitchen, decked out with high-end stainless-steel appliances, is ready for anything from pancake breakfasts to seafood delights. In the living room, a huge TV and direct pool access make it the ultimate hangout spot. Down the hall, a primary suite, with king bed, dual vanity, walk-in shower, and soaking tub, isn’t far from two additional guest rooms, each with a king bed, private bath, and walk-in shower. The first-floor primary suite is a dream, with a king bed, spa-like bathroom, and soaking tub.

Two more guest suites, each with a king bed, private bath, and walk-in shower, are just down the hall. Upstairs, the bunk room is built for fun, featuring three full-over-full bunks, a private bath, and a spacious shower. But the real second-floor showstopper? The lounge, with tons of cozy seating and a massive smart TV. Hop in the house elevator and ride up to the crown jewel, a fourth-floor observation deck with breathtaking Gulf views and sunsets worth toasting to. The sugar-white sand is just two blocks away, an easy walk or bike ride, and Seaside is a quick 10-minute stroll. At Oversee 30A, we make vacationing easy, with clean, comfortable stays with a local team always nearby. Our office is just down the road, open seven days a week, with 24/7 support. Sea you soon! Overview: - 434 steps (.2 miles) to the beach (Scenic 395 Access) - 4 bedroom, 4.5 bath - 4714 sq ft - Gas grill - Wi-Fi - 4 bikes included - Fire pit - Private pool (can be heated seasonally for an additional $55.00 per day, contact Oversee for details) Overnight: FIRST FLOOR - Primary Bedroom: King bed, private bath, walk-in shower and tub, TV - Guest Room: King bed, private bath, walk-in shower, TV - Guest Room: King bed, private bath, walk-in shower, TV SECOND FLOOR - Guest Bunkroom: 3 full over full bunks, private bath, walk-in shower Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
